chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
There is no harm in exchanging goods so long as they are not by measure or by weight.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no legal objection or harm

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to exchange goods in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning exchange transactions. It indicates that exchanging goods is permissible when the items are not of the kind sold by measure or weight, which relates to the fiqh of ribā.
